mentions.name: Zustri
mentions.description: This app provides booking and scheduling for therapists and salons. It includes an AI agent, a public booking page, and support for multiple staff, and is in final polish ahead of launch.
mentions.problem: The author's girlfriend is a therapist and didn't like any of the booking/scheduling software she tried, so he built one for her.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Zustri (https://zustri.com), booking and scheduling for therapists and salons.
mentions.author: dinja15
